system.description:
Your knowledge of Law lets you understand legal processes, courts and lawyers, and use them effectively — whether upholding the law or twisting it to your own ends.

Use Law in court situations or with Social Challenges involving legal matters. Because the field is so vast, the Storyteller may require you to select an area (Criminal, Civil, Tax, etc.); alternately, you may study Kindred law in depth.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
